```{r}
# Downloading DHS Surveys

# Accessing DHS
# Install and load rdhs
# install.packages("rdhs")
library(rdhs)

# 1. Set up your DHS credentials (you will be prompted for your password)
set_rdhs_config(
  email = "gag103@georgetown.edu",
  project = "Data Science for Public Policy Final Project — Drought Exposure and Child Stunting"
)

# 2. Find and download datasets automatically (e.g., all Individual Recode files for Kenya)

ssa_countries <- c(
  "AO", "BJ", "BF", "BU", "CM", "CF", "TD", "KM", "CG", "CD", 
  "CI", "SZ", "ET", "GA", "GM", "GH", "GN", "KE", "LS", "LR", 
  "MG", "MW", "ML", "MR", "MZ", "NM", "NI", "NG", "RW", 
  "ST", "SN", "SL", "ZA", "SD", "TZ", "TG", "UG", "ZW", "ZM"
)

# 2. Get the most recent standard DHS survey for each selected country
recent_surveys <- dhs_surveys(
  countryIds = ssa_countries,
  surveyType = "DHS"
) |>
  group_by(DHS_CountryCode) |>
  slice_max(order_by = as.numeric(SurveyYear), n = 1) |>
  ungroup()

# 3. Build the dataset request matching your screenshot (Children's Recode + Stata)
datasets <- dhs_datasets(
  surveyIds  = recent_surveys$SurveyId,
  fileType   = "KR", # Children's Recode
  fileFormat = "DT"  # Stata System file (.dta)
)

# 4. Download all matching files and get local paths
local_paths <- get_datasets(datasets$FileName)

# 4. Read the first downloaded dataset directly into R
# df <- readRDS(local_paths[[1]])

```

```{r}
# Downloading GPS data from DHS

# 1. Query the Geographic Data (GPS) files for the same surveys
gps_datasets <- dhs_datasets(
  surveyIds = recent_surveys$SurveyId,
  fileType  = "GE" # Geographic Data (Cluster GPS coordinates)
)

# 2. Download the GPS zip files (use download_option = "zip" since they are shapefiles)
# Set clear_cache = TRUE if you only recently got DHS approval for GPS data
gps_zip_paths <- get_datasets(
  dataset_filenames = gps_datasets$FileName,
  download_option   = "zip",
  clear_cache       = TRUE
)

# Reading files into R
# 1. Create a folder for extracted shapefiles and unzip all archives
dir.create("dhs_gps_unzipped", showWarnings = FALSE)
lapply(gps_zip_paths, unzip, exdir = "dhs_gps_unzipped")

# 2. List all extracted .shp files
shp_files <- list.files("dhs_gps_unzipped", pattern = "\\.shp$", full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

# 3. Read each shapefile into a named list of sf data frames
gps_list <- lapply(shp_files, st_read, quiet = TRUE)
names(gps_list) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(shp_files))

# Optional: Unpack into individual objects in your Global Environment
# list2env(gps_list, envir = .GlobalEnv)

```

```{r}
# Extracting Variables

my_vars <- c(
  # IDs, design, dates
  "caseid","bidx","v000","v001","v002","v005","v021","v022","v024","v025",
  "v006","v007","v008","b3",
  # outcome + sample
  "hw70","hw1","b5","hw13",
  # child
  "b4","bord","b0","b11","m18","m19",
  # mother
  "v011","v012","v106","v133","v438","v445","v501","v201","v206","v207","v212",
  # household
  "v136","v137","v151","v152","v190","v191","v113","v115","v116","v160",
  "v161","v119","v120","v121","v122","v127","v104",
  # access, land, place, partner
  "v467d","v481","v483a","v745b","v040","v701","v715"
)

qs <- search_variables(datasets$FileName, variables = my_vars)

# coverage check: how many of your surveys have each variable
qs |> count(variable, sort = TRUE) |> print()

extracted_list <- extract_dhs(qs, add_geo = FALSE)
kr <- rbind_labelled(extracted_list, labels = "concatenate")
##
qs |> count(variable, sort = TRUE) |> as_tibble() |> print(n = Inf)
```
